description: Lab Tests with Wireless Sensor Network (WSN) system for the characterization of strong wind loads on non-structural components is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "experimental", published or maintained by Chelakara Subramanian, Florida Institute of Technology (fit.edu). The goal is to better understand the interaction of hurricane and other strong wind events with non-structural components of residential structures. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "experimental" project. Keywords: wireless sensor network pressure measurements - large scale testing - wall of wind. Published 2024-02-19. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is 3-Clause BSD License. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
